prose: A SemiAnalysis analysis of 857 releases from nine Chinese AI labs between 2021 and September 2026 finds only 3.6% included safety results from the developer and just 1.1% did so at launch. It frames this against the safety debate after Dario Amodei's September essay arguing frontier labs should slow down.
